description: This file defines a Go package for Kubernetes client apply configurations related to the Namespace resource, including functions for constructing, extracting, and modifying Namespace configurations for declarative management.

classes.name: NamespaceApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes Namespace resource, supporting fluent builder methods for setting metadata, spec, and status.

methods.name: Namespace
methods.description: Constructs a new NamespaceApplyConfiguration with specified name, kind 'Namespace', and API version 'v1'.

methods.name: ExtractNamespaceFrom
methods.description: Extracts an apply configuration for a Namespace from an existing corev1.Namespace object, given a field manager and optional subresource.

methods.name: ExtractNamespace
methods.description: Extracts an apply configuration for a Namespace owned by a specific field manager.

methods.name: ExtractNamespaceStatus
methods.description: Extracts the apply configuration for the status subresource of a Namespace.

methods.name: IsApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Method to identify the struct as an apply configuration.

methods.name: WithKind
methods.description: Sets the Kind field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAPIVersion
methods.description: Sets the APIVersion field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the Name in the ObjectMeta of the configuration.

methods.name: WithGenerateName
methods.description: Sets the GenerateName in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithNamespace
methods.description: Sets the Namespace in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithUID
methods.description: Sets the UID in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithResourceVersion
methods.description: Sets the ResourceVersion in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithGeneration
methods.description: Sets the Generation in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithCreationTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the CreationTimestamp in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithDeletionTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the DeletionTimestamp in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithDeletionGracePeriodSeconds
methods.description: Sets the DeletionGracePeriodSeconds in the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithLabels
methods.description: Adds label entries to the Labels map in ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithAnnotations
methods.description: Adds annotation entries to the Annotations map in ObjectMeta.

methods.name: WithOwnerReferences
methods.description: Appends OwnerReference configurations to the OwnerReferences slice.

methods.name: WithFinalizers
methods.description: Appends finalizer strings to the Finalizers slice.

methods.name: ensureObjectMetaApplyConfigurationExists
methods.description: Ensures the ObjectMetaApplyConfiguration field is initialized.

methods.name: WithSpec
methods.description: Sets the Spec field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithStatus
methods.description: Sets the Status field in the configuration.

methods.name: GetKind
methods.description: Retrieves the Kind value from the configuration.

methods.name: GetAPIVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the APIVersion value from the configuration.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Retrieves the Name value from the ObjectMeta.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the Namespace value from the ObjectMeta.
